## Background

![Source: New Yorker](https://media.newyorker.com/photos/6331dc33105812508a066849/master/w_2560%2Cc_limit/PR%2520Hurricane%2520Final.jpg)

In September 1989, Hurricane Hugo hit Puerto Rico. This project analyzes water quality data from various freshwater systems in Puerto Rico after the hurricane. The goal is to recreate figure 3 from Schaefer et al. (2000).

![Source: Schaefer et al. (2000)](https://eds-214-reproducibility-m26.github.io/course-materials/interactive/images/Schaefer_etal_2020_fig3.png)

## Data

Data was acesssed via McDowell and International Institute Of Tropical Forestry (IITF) (2024). Each row represents a 9 week window. Columns include site, date, ion, and concentration. There were 4 sites: Bisley Q1, Bisley Q2, Bisley Q3, and Rio Mameyes River. Ions measured include Calcium, Potassium, Magnesium, Ammonium, and Ammonia.

```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false
# load libraries and data
library(tidyverse)
cdat <- read_csv('../output/cleaned_data.csv')
```

## Methods

To prepare data for plotting, 9-week moving averages were calculated for each site and ion. Data was also filtered to relevant years. 

In the code below, we reformat the structure of the data in order to graph it.

```{r}
# reformat data into long format
cdat_long <- cdat |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(k_mgl, no3, mg_mgl, ca, nh4),
    names_to = 'Ion',
    values_to = 'Concentration'
  )
```

## Results

Concentrations of potassium, calcium, magnesium and ammonia have increased since the hurricane hit. They have gradually decreased in the 4 years since the hurricane, except for magnesium which has increased. Overall, the graph we generated looks fairly similar to figure 3 from Schaefer et al. (2000).

```{r}
#| warning: false
# multiplot for each ion and site
plot1 <- cdat_long |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = window_start, y = Concentration, linetype = site)
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(Ion),
    scales = 'free',
    ncol = 1,
    strip.position = "left",
    labeller = labeller(
      Ion = c( # relabel ion names
        'ca' = 'Ca mg l-1',
        'k_mgl' = 'K mg l-1',
        'mg_mgl' = 'Mg mg l-1',
        'nh4' = 'NH4-N µg l-1',
        'no3' = 'NO3-N µg l-1'
      )
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ymd('1989-09-17'), linetype = 'dashed') + # add when the hurricane hit
  labs(x = 'Years', y = 'Concentration of Ions') +
  theme_bw()

plot1
```
